context_and_flow.ux_intent: Welcome the user and prompt them to enter the application environment.
ux_patterns: The hero image of a fitness celebrity acts as a strong visual anchor for the brand.
The layout uses a dark overlay at the bottom to ensure text readability over the image.
The CTA button is high contrast (light text on a dark background) and prominent.
The design uses a clean sans-serif typeface.
The illustration is a realistic hero character/portrait, reinforcing the fitness lifestyle and brand authority.
